pr_title: Add interactive select in gist view
pr_comments:
Hi @vilmibm, this PR is ready to review now. Thanks!

The format would be like:
```sh
? Select a gist  [Use arrows to move, type to filter]
> foo.txt (about 13 minutes ago)
  gistfile.txt (about 13 minutes ago)
```

issue_context.title: interactive select in gist view
issue_context.body: I'd like `gist view` (no arguments) to open a selectable list of the user's most recent 10 gists to avoid the `gist list`, copy, `gist view <pasted id>` flow.
comments: @vilmibm I'd like to pick this up. Can you assign it to me if someone isn't already working on it?
Hi @g14a, sorry for interrupting. Actually, I'm working  on this (still need to add some tests) but forgot to leave a comment here. Do you mind if I continue?
Oh no problem. Please continue. Good luck! :)

review_comments: these are good tests :+1: please also add one test to the `gist view` tests just to ensure that we go into interactive mode when no ID is supplied (it doesn't have to test anything beyond that since you're doing that here).
Tests added. Could you please have a look? Thanks.
thank you for remembering to do this :pray:

Since `gist list` simply return when there are no any gists, so I keep the behavior consistent in `gist` command.
Or message like "There are no gists from [username]" should be returned?
I think a message saying that the user has no gists would be a nice improvement, here.

Would it be better to display current username? Or just "There are no gists from current user".
If showing username is preferred, is there any way to access current username other than passing in parameter to `viewRun`?
